items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: He and Carney too. And they played something alike but I don't think they ever even met each other.

ctx.x: He's one of the best I've ever heard. He and Carney too. And they played something alike but I don't think they ever even met each other.
I've never heard of, well I mean I've heard of the Irwin Brothers but I didn't know you know, that there were three of them like that.
